note: How each platform actually enforces. Automated content matching is the dominant mechanism by volume and does not evaluate fair use, so platform exposure tracks DETECTABILITY rather than legal merit. Re-verify against each platform's published help centre before relying on the strike numbers.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.trademark_complaint: Separate trademark complaint form, reviewed by a human; distinct from the copyright process and does not create a copyright strike.
platforms.privacy_complaint: Privacy complaint process; the subject must file personally, and YouTube may require the uploader to blur or remove.
platforms.note: 2.5 billion Content ID claims in 2025, 99%+ automated. Rights holders chose to monetise over 90% of them, so the usual outcome is revenue diversion rather than removal. A Content ID claim is NOT a strike; a DMCA takedown is.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.trademark_complaint: IP infringement report form covering trademark separately from copyright.
platforms.privacy_complaint: Privacy report; stricter defaults for minors.
platforms.note: Commercial tracks in the general library are licensed for personal use only — using one on a business or branded account is a common and under-known breach. Muting is the typical automated remedy rather than revenue sharing.

platforms.name: Instagram / Meta
platforms.privacy_complaint: Meta privacy reporting; images of minors handled under separate policy.
platforms.note: Rights Manager performs the matching. Music availability differs between personal and professional/business accounts, so the same audio can clear on one account and be muted on another.

platforms.name: Twitch
platforms.note: Audio matching runs over VODs and clips rather than the live stream, so a violation typically surfaces after broadcast.

platforms.name: No platform (theatrical, festival, broadcast delivery)
platforms.trademark_complaint: None — exposure runs through the distributor and the E&O carrier instead.
platforms.privacy_complaint: None — releases are checked at delivery.
platforms.note: No automated enforcement exists here, which makes clearance MORE important rather than less: there is no takedown to react to, only a distributor rejecting delivery or a claim after release.
